description.value:
The pleasant smell gives you good appetite, so you choose not to ask why seeds planted on Protein Rice can yield flowers.

"The wind carries its fragrance down the waterway."

D&D 5e Effect

As an action, consume this item and choose the creatures in your Main Party who can see you. The benefit begins when the next combat starts and lasts for 1 minute. When an affected creature restores hit points, one target regains additional hit points equal to proficiency bonus. A creature can benefit from only one synthesized pre-combat consumable at a time; a new one replaces the previous one.

GM Description — Original HSR Effect

Upon use, increases all allies' HP restored by 18% for the next battle.
